title: Carter asks CIA director George H.W. Bush for UFO briefing and is refused

tellings.quote: he sent for the head of the Central Intelligence Agency to come down to Plains Georgia uh even before he had gone to Washington

plain: After he won the 1976 election, and before he even moved to Washington, Jimmy Carter is said to have called the head of the CIA, George H. W. Bush, down to his home town of Plains, Georgia, to brief him on UFOs, and Bush refused. Dan Sheehan, a guest presented as someone tied up in many of America's famous conspiracy cases, tells it as an account passed on to him. If true, it would mean the spy agency kept UFO secrets even from an incoming president.
